paite: Zahngaihna leh vaihawmna dik thu la in ka sa ding a; TOUPA aw, nangmah phat in la ka sa ding.
heading: David Phatna La / Kumpipa Thuchiam
english: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.

paite: Lam hoihkim ah piltak in ka om ding. Aw chikchiang in ahia ka kiang a na hong pai ding? Ka insung ah lungtang hoihkim pu in ka om ding hi.
english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

paite: Thil hoihloute ka mitmuh ah ka koih kei ding, lampialte thilhih ka hua ahi; keimah ah abang kei ding hi.
english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

paite: Lungtang genhak in hon paisan ding a; thil gilou himhim ka thei kei ding hi.
english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

paite: Kuapeuh a-invengte aguk a gen, huai mi ka hihmang ding a; mi mit tunghah leh lungtang kisathei pumi ka thuak thei kei ding hi.
english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

paite: Hiai gam a mi muanhuaite tung ah ka mit atu ding a, ka kiang a a-omtheihna ding un; lam hoihkim tawnmi in ka nna asem ding hi.
english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

paite: Khem hat ka insung ah a-om kei ding a; ka mitmuh ah mizuauhat hihkip in a-om kei ding hi.
english: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

paite: Zingsang teng in hiai gam a migilou-salou tengteng ka hihmang ding a; TOUPA khopi a kipan thil hihkhial tengteng hihmang ding in.
english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.
